limits: Lifecycle sweeps are reported separately from explicit effect assertions.
Native hooks are inherited from the pinned simulator; conditional field behavior is exercised in abilities-complete-modes.test.js.
Honey Gather retains its pre-existing overworld_pending classification; it has no in-battle effect.
The 56 catalog abilities exclusive to later species are inventoried but are outside the currently playable species scope.
fixes: Imposter/Transform checkpoints with fewer copied moves restore without dummy moves or changed PP.
Multitype has 17 actual held Plates; Judgment resolves their type; Arceus plate binding matches native Gen7.
Boss knockout presentation completes before reward access.
